scripts.demo:lint: eslint -c eslint.demo.config.mjs packages/eslint-stats packages/eslint-next testing/utils -f json -o tmp/lint-report.json
scripts.demo:lint:parallel: eslint -c eslint.demo.config.mjs packages/eslint-stats packages/eslint-next testing/utils -f json -o tmp/lint-report.json --concurrency=3
scripts.demo:empty: rm -rf profiles/empty && node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir=profiles/empty node_modules/.bin/eslint -c eslint.demo.config.mjs packages/eslint-stats packages/eslint-next testing/utils -f json -o tmp/lint-report.json --concurrency=3
scripts.demo:stitch: rm -rf profiles/parallel && NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 cpu-prof measure --no-flagMain --cpu-prof-dir ./profiles/parallel node node_modules/.bin/eslint -c eslint.demo.config.mjs packages/eslint-stats packages/eslint-next testing/utils -f json -o tmp/lint-report.json --concurrency=3
scripts.demo:stitch:plain: rm -rf profiles/plain && NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 cpu-prof measure --no-flagMain --cpu-prof-dir ./profiles/plain node node_modules/.bin/eslint -c eslint.demo.config.mjs packages/eslint-stats packages/eslint-next testing/utils -f json -o tmp/lint-report.json
scripts.demo:prepare: npm run demo:lint && npm run demo:empty && npm run demo:stitch && npm run demo:stitch:plain && rm -rf demo-fallback && cp -R profiles demo-fallback && echo 'Fallbacks ready in demo-fallback/'
